title: Compound Growth Factor
brief: A financial planning service projects balances with a per-period growth factor. To project forward or discount backward, it needs the factor applied over a whole number of periods, where a negative number of periods means going back in time.
Implement growthOverPeriods(x, n), where x is the per-period factor as a floating-point number and n is the integer number of periods, and return x raised to the power n.
